experiment: E1 Pyodide cold start in a worker, throttled 4G/3G

variants.no_numpy: no wheel loaded, same workload in pure Python
variants.with_pandas: numpy + pandas loaded (pandas never used for the plot)

environment.timing: performance.now() from navigation start to the 2nd rAF after drawing

assets.note: total_*_bytes cover every file the server can serve, i.e. all variants together; what one cold start actually downloads is per-run `bytes.server_wire` (baseline 9.35 MB, no_numpy 6.39 MB, +pandas 14.28 MB).
